name: stft_welch
output_format: unsigned32 integer power bins, records of K=33 (one-sided) or 64 (two-sided), tuser={LAST,SOF}
averaging: block A=2**cfg_avg (1..256) or exponential alpha=cfg_avg (1..8), 42-bit per-bin state
psd_units: P[k]*2^pshift*2^12/(fs*U_q), interior one-sided bins x2; U_q=sum(w_q^2)
rounding: RNE once per reduction stage; deterministic fft64 stage wrap preserved
configuration: atomic in IDLE only; legal commit clears buffer/averager/counters; illegal whole-field reject
throughput_bound: sustained input <= H/T_frame samples/clk (~H/910); 128-entry buffer decouples bursts only
latency_no_stall: ~900 clocks frame-complete to first emitted bin; bins at II=1 while unstallled
dsp_budget_note: 5 MULT18X18 (window_mult 1 + mag_squared 4) exceeds the 4-DSP board-image budget; a board build needs a LUT-multiply mag variant or DSP sharing
